description: Pull new mail from the tenant's IMAP mailbox now, instead of waiting for somebody to open the app and click. Optional: email_account_id (defaults to the tenant's only mailbox), limit (newest N, default 50, max 500 — use 500 for a first pass over a mailbox that has been collecting). Mails already stored have their subject, sender, body and attachment flag refreshed; status, classification and any job or lead links are left alone. Returns fetched and refreshed counts. Gmail: folder (a label from list_mail_folders, e.g. SPAM or TRASH) fetches only that label — the default pull skips SPAM and TRASH. Mehrere Postfächer: ohne Angabe gilt das Standard-Postfach des Agenten (set_agent_mailboxes), sonst zuerst list_mailboxes.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: fetch_inbox
